name: ZZTEST_NOID -> ZZTEST_NOID_UPDATED
notes: CLEANED UP - deleted successfully via DELETE /products/price-list/1763. Confirmed the real create endpoint is POST products/price-list (no id in URL, contrary to docs which show an id) - returns a new id. Confirmed update works via POST products/price-list/{id} with _method:PATCH, changing rate 111->222 on product 130407 and name/description, verified via GET before/after. PATCH/POST-with-id against a non-existent id reliably crashes with HTTP 500 rather than a clean error - this is what makes the docs' own example (PATCHing an id that doesn't exist yet, calling it 'create') actually broken.
